column1: # Triage of upstream advisories for ported packages (PLAN.md, upstream tracking).
# scripts/upstream_watch.py lists advisories found here as triaged.
# Verdict: covered (a Rust test pins the fixed behaviour), not-ported (the
# vulnerable code has no Rust counterpart), or affected (fix pending).

column4: HeaderUtils::split ReDoS: header_utils.rs tokenizes linearly (no regex); upstream fix test ported as crates/http-foundation/tests/header_utils_test.rs::testSplitIsNotAmbiguousAboutWhitespaceBeforeSeparators (moved from accept_language.rs when HeaderUtils.php was ported, 2026-11-22). The oracle shows v8.1.6 failing those inputs (backtrack limit) and the pin matching the Rust results. Triaged 2026-11-19.

UrlGenerator dot segments: the whole-path step was not ported; added as generator::encode_dot_segments with the upstream tests testEncodingOfRelativePathSegments and testEncodingOfChainedRelativePathSegments. symfony-demo-rs was not reachable (slug and component parameters cannot be dot segments). Triaged 2026-11-19.
UrlGenerator requirement check with unanchored regex alternation: the crate has no regex requirements; parameters are typed segments (decision 10 will keep requirements anchored). Triaged 2026-11-19.

IpUtils::PRIVATE_SUBNETS omitting IPv6 transition forms: IpUtils.php ported at v8.1.11 (PLAN.md decision 16) with the full list; the fix's provider rows are crates/http-foundation/tests/ip_utils_test.rs::testIsPrivateIp (::7f00:1, 2002:7f00:1::, 2001::1, 64:ff9b::7f00:1, ...), plus ::testPrivateRangesDoNotCoverAddressesARemoteClientCanPresent. The oracle (scripts/record.sh http-foundation-releases) shows v8.0.8 answering false for 13 transition-form addresses that v8.0.13 and the Rust port answer true. scheme.rs still trusts exact proxy IPs only. Triaged 2026-11-19, covered 2026-11-23.
PATH_INFO parsing: no base URL or PATH_INFO derivation; the HTTP adapter passes the request path. Revisit with Request::preparePathInfo (M2). Triaged 2026-11-19.
HEAD bypassing methods filters of #[IsGranted]/#[IsSignatureValid]/#[IsCsrfTokenValid]: those attribute listeners are not ported. Revisit with M2/M5 security listeners. Triaged 2026-11-19.

Unbounded recursion in the inline lexer: the fix's tests are ported as crates/yaml/tests/parser_test.rs::testParseRejectsUnterminatedInlineSequencesThatExceedTheNestingDepth, ::testParseRejectsUnterminatedInlineMappingsThatExceedTheNestingDepth and ::testParseAcceptsInlineSequencesAtTheNestingDepth. The oracle shows v8.1.5 failing them ("Malformed inline YAML string" instead of the nesting-depth ParseException) and the pin matching the Rust results. Triaged 2026-11-21.

ReDoS in Parser::cleanup(): the Rust patterns run on the regex crate (linear time). The fix's tests (parser_test.rs::testParseHandlesLargeYamlHeaders, ::testParseHandlesLargeLeadingComments, ::testParseHandlesLargeDocumentMarkers) pass on v8.0.11 too, so crates/yaml/tests/advisories.rs pins inputs that v8.0.11 fails on the oracle (backtrack limit: a TypeError, a --- marker kept) and the pin's answers. Triaged 2026-11-21.

Billion laughs through collection aliases: the fix's tests are ported (parser_test.rs::testParseRejectsDocumentsThatExceedTheConfiguredCollectionAliasLimit, ::testParseCountsTaggedValueCollectionAliases, ::testParseAcceptsScalarAliasesWithoutCountingThem, ::testParseAcceptsLargeCollectionAliasedOnce, ::testParseRejectsBlockAliasesWhenDisabled, ::testParseRejectsInlineAliasesWhenDisabled; yaml_test.rs::testParseFileAllowsConfiguringTheMaximumCollectionAliasCount). The oracle shows v8.0.11 accepting the limit test's document and the pin rejecting it. Triaged 2026-11-21.

Unbounded nesting in block and inline parsing: the fix's tests are ported (parser_test.rs::testParseRejectsDocumentsThatExceedTheDefaultNestingDepth; yaml_test.rs::testParseAllowsConfiguringTheMaximumNestingLevel). The oracle shows v8.0.11 accepting 129 nested levels and the pin rejecting them, as Rust does. Triaged 2026-11-21.
